title: twelve-block-prompt-schema v1
purpose: A minimal Python dataclass schema that encodes the twelve-block prompt contract (observed in art_01M67CGQR5M8AXXN18VH6Z4ETM r1) as typed fields. Validates that continuity-block entries name known references, that each condition is flagged as repeated in the scene context, that camera segments are ordered, and that quality rules are positively framed. Emits a machine-readable JSON integration contract. Intended as a reusable adapter skeleton for multi-clip Seedance projects.
